title: Sony 50.3 mm f/1.45 full-frame imaging lens (US20190004278A1, example 5)

collection.attribution: Sony Corp, US20190004278A1 "Imaging lens and imaging apparatus". The prescription is the published numerical example 5; the native Project is a transcription of its surface table.
collection.redistribution: The native Project and record metadata are distributed under MIT. The patent document is cited as the direct source.

aperture_validity.basis: The publication states no clear or mechanical semi-diameter, so the transcription uses one uniform clear semi-diameter; the stop row is then the same size as its neighbours and does not bound the beam.
aperture_validity.satisfaction_basis: No pupil or field evidence is recorded, and the modelled stop does not bound the beam, so no stop-dependent match is claimed.
aperture_validity.consequence: The record supports first-order and structural queries only; a stop-dependent constraint stays unconfirmed.

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: The publication prints the d-line as its reference wavelength (587.56 nm in air). That value is converted once to the vacuum wavelength the engine evaluates, as the existing patent-derived records do.
spectrum.wavelength_precision: A single sample; no rounding in the Project.

sampling_span_nm.note: One sample, so the span is a 1 nm numerical window around it. It is not a second wavelength and not a measured band: sampling_wavelengths_nm holds exactly one value.

continuous_coverage_nm.note: The example states one reference wavelength only.

image_format.basis: SOURCE_STATED: the 36 × 24 mm dimensions describe the intended format of the cited design.
image_format.image_circle_diameter_basis: DERIVED: source-only estimate 2 f tan(omega). Project coverage is unconfirmed.

field.definition: Object-space half angle printed for the cited example.
field.image_height_basis: DERIVED: source-only estimate f tan(omega) from the printed focal length and half field.

effective_focal_length_mm.definition: Signed paraxial effective focal length of the committed Project.

back_focal_length_mm.definition: Signed paraxial distance from the last optical surface vertex to the rear focal point, positive downstream.

total_track_mm.definition: Sum of the tabulated thicknesses from the first surface to the image plane in the committed Project.

engine_check.method: Thick-lens ABCD through the committed Project at the reference wavelength.

f_number.convention: Image-space F-number as printed for the example (Fno).
f_number.definition: image-space f-number; this is the system aperture the record declares, taken from the value the source states for the example

materials.basis: Each Project material uses a constant index at the reference wavelength, based on the publication’s d-line index. The printed Abbe numbers are outside the material model.

approximations.statement: Each element uses its printed d-line refractive index as a constant at the reference wavelength. The printed Abbe numbers are outside the material model.
The publication states no semi-diameters; the Project uses one uniform 13.0 mm clear semi-diameter for every surface, which does not affect first-order properties.
The Project represents infinity focus. See the cited example for spacings at closer conjugates.
